system.description:
Range unlimited on the same plane; one creature you know by name or sight. You send a message of up to 25 words and it may reply in 25 words. Add a command: the target must make a Will save or follow a single stated course of action (not suicidal or harmful to itself) for up to 24 hours. Will negates the command.

Classes: Wizard, Witch
system.range: Range unlimited on the same plane
